text:
Supply order for Ellmere depot.
Personnel: Bram out (Greta covering); Dell out (Rafe covering); Jonah/Bram swapping desks. Pia/Leon swapping desks. Greta covers Mira (out all week). Cora/Mira swapping desks. Suri/Nils swapping desks. Una/Vik swapping desks. Leon/Teo swapping desks. Teo covers Una (out rest of week).
Issues: Lifts near loading bay, east wing, north office, print room, library annex, and garden studio are slow. East wing too cold in afternoon. Garden studio, loading bay, harbour room, and east wing being repainted (noise). East wing also repainted (evening noise). Umbrella left in loading bay and garden studio. Mira and Una think north office is too cold in the evening.
Order items: 515 crates.
Notes: Finn, Mira, and Teo want north office/loading bay/garden studio kept clear for visitors. Ines, Leon prefer east wing for reviews. Bram, Kira prefer loading bay. Teo, Ada prefer garden studio. Wren prefers north office. Opal asked if print room is free in morning; Opal prefers loading bay and harbour room for reviews. Coffee machines in north office, library annex, and loading bay are working. Morning stand-up in north office; afternoon in library annex. User needs to send Esme, Mira, Opal, Vik, and Kira notes from morning meeting. Assistant offered to draft note to Greta. Vik and Wren are involved. Check with Kira and Hugo before morning meeting.
